programmes.d: A sports fan's romantic courtship clashes with his obsession with his favorite football team. Based on the book by Nick Hornby.

After ten years, a young aristocrat invites his college theatrical friends and mates for a New Year's reunion, BIG CHILL-style. As the eating and drinking proceed, all manner of former relationships, emotional traumas and secret agendas are revealed.

When Daniel's father dies, it is up to him to arrange the funeral. On this painful morning, Daniel prepares to welcome his father's friends and relatives. But preserving the dignity inherent in such circumstances will be a hard task.

A comedy about a star high-school jock and how every major college in the United States attempts to recruit him and other promising football stars illegally by promising them free booze, willing cheerleaders, hard cash, lear jets and no homework.
Adam gets engaged to a waitress and has affairs with both her sisters. The lad is certainly playing the field, but in their own ways the girls seem to be getting just as much out of the deal as him.
